**This GitHub repository is a read-only mirror.** The canonical repository lives on
our Forgejo instance:

https://forgejo.ekaii.fr/Ekaii/beatbump

GitHub is updated by a push mirror and nothing is merged here. Pull requests opened
on GitHub are not reviewed; please open them on Forgejo instead (registration is
open, sign in and fork `Ekaii/beatbump`). Issues are welcome there too.

If you only want to report a security problem, see `SECURITY.md`.
